title: Zung Zung Zen

page_data.en:

4/3/16.
Shanghai Municipal Council.
July 4th 1916

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

Sir,

It is reported that the members of the Koumingtang held a meeting at No.5 Paul Beau on 3rd instant with a view to uniting all the functions of their party.
It is said that they decided to disband all ex-soldiers who were being paid out of the society's funds.
They also decided to form a new society to be known as the Zung Zung Zen
The troops at the Arsenal and Woosung have not yet been paid for the month of June.
The Commander of the Woosung forts has reported to General Yang that the war ships outside Woosung are behaving in a suspicious manner.
Admiral Sah paid a second visit to Lunghwa on the afternoon of 3rd inst.
The newspaper guild has petitioned the President requesting him to withdraw the censorship on telegrams from different parts of the country.

Your Obedient Servant,

Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

16年3月4日。
上海工部局。
1916年7月4日

（印：上海工部局）
警务处，
（侦探股）

先生：

据报，国民党成员于本月3日在宝昌路5号举行会议，旨在统一该党各项职能。
据悉，他们决定遣散所有由该党经费供养的前士兵。
他们还决定组建一个新社团，名为“Zung Zung Zen”（音译）。
兵工厂和吴淞的部队尚未领取六月份的薪饷。
吴淞炮台指挥官已向杨将军报告，称吴淞外海的军舰行为可疑。
萨海军上将于本月3日下午第二次访问龙华。
报业公会已呈请大总统，请求撤销对来自全国各地电报的新闻检查。

您顺从的仆人，

总探长。

警务处总监。
